notes.title: Icebreaker Update
notes.notes:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/9117305/510895ac652ae99061d4c43dc1e44aae4e7d256f.png

Agents, gear up for an exhilarating winter! We've launched Rose Cottage, a new live sandbox online [come check it out] to usher in the next era of The Black Watchmen. Plus we’re rolling out an expansive update to the Steam client, ensuring your missions are more engaging and realistic than ever. 

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/9117305/2b6188a2f61d373f5e1b7da8a0b67deffeabaf4e.png
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/9117305/7ba01ee246ac029c5d1cc9d0aaa51fed7fe3b08a.png
JOIN THE INVESTIGATION 
Live Now: We've created an immersive sandbox to release missions exploring new puzzle, narrative and tech possibilities that will be regularly updated.

TBW Leaks: Something major is coming to The Black Watchmen, and Rose Cottage is the best way to keep up to date with all the news! 

Completely Free on Browser: Anyone can join in the Rose Cottage investigations - completely free - all you need is a web browser. 

Collaborative: Join your fellow agents as they solve cases in real time on 
Discord!. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9117305/b1d446e54391f1564c89adff4658e0f11c051179.pngMajor QA Overhaul:  We've rigorously tested and refined Season 1, Season 2, and all DLCs. Expect a smoother, more immersive experience.

Updated Mission Intel:  We've revised mission documents to mirror current real-world dynamics. This includes replacing outdated resources (Rest in Power, encipher.it) with the latest intel.

Notice:   As of Dec 21, 2023, all missions are solvable. If you still encounter issue solving your puzzle, visit our discord server. It is likely you did not find the right answer or use outdated guide.

Client Optimization:  We've upgraded the client for improved video performance, and increased scalability to better support larger monitors. 

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/9117305/8a270c6ec97c626143cbecc4a5bd9321efe4c60f.png
Client Updates:

Updated game engine to Unity 2023 
Added video resolution and quality options.
General reduction of loading time.
Added Incognito Login
Mac OS compatibility

Mission Updates:

Updated in-world websites 
Over 15 puzzle fixes to missions in Season 1, Season 2, Alone in the Dark Web and Mother Russia 
Complete rework of missions involving out of date OSINT


Agents, your dedication and skill have been the cornerstone of our success. Enjoy Rose Cottage and we look forward to all 2024 has in store!

notes.title: FULL RELEASE
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25311468/8cdce2c59ca24d17f532b945772adb40b50abbcf.jpg

 
Dreamers, it’s finally here!
Enter the dream world of Ahnayro, where shadowy figures, terror, and the only possibility of salvation all lurk. Strange presences weave in and out of your mind as you journey into the darkest shadows of your dreams. Confront inner demons and lurking evils as you seek the truth, a truth found in between two worlds: the waking and the dreaming.


We’ve worked hard for over a year now on adding the complete depth and complexity that the dream world Ahnayro deserves. The dream fragment riddles act as rabbit holes, inviting you deeper into the mysteries of the dream world, while the narrative, soundtrack, and images act as breadcrumbs, showing you that you’re on the right path as you progress along your investigation.


We have made changes to Table 1 and Table 2 to deepen the immersion and to further connect the complexity of the puzzles with the overarching narrative. Join the dreamer as she navigates her dreams and tries to save herself from her own inner turmoil and illness.


As before, don’t forget to visit us on the forums to meet your fellow oneironauts and to discuss what you see beyond the veil of reality.


http://store.steampowered.com/app/449730/

notes.title: DEV UPDATE
notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/8ZJk5DV.jpg

Hi everyone! I would like to take the time to give an update on the current projects at Alice and Smith. 

It’s been a year since we launched The Black Watchmen and if you read the  Almanac, you know that a lot has happened in the last 12 months. For me, it was by far the most exciting year as a puppet master and a game developer. We have launched a second (and soon a third) game, nearly doubled the size of our community and successfully kidnapped one of our players. It has been a thrill ride.

As we look forward to the Fall months, there is a lot on the horizon. We are set to release the full version of Ahnayro at the end of September, expand NITE Team 4 and further broaden the universe of The Black Watchmen.


-- THE BLACK WATCHMEN 
Many of you are eager for the announcement of Season 3, and we don’t blame you! We are excited about the story we want to tell, however before we officially announce the launch date of a new season, we believe we need to improve the core quality of the game and define how we must evolve the ARG experience to the next level. Mother Russia was an opportunity to test all that we had learned over the past year:


-The live event was a great experience for both us and the community. While there were many amazing moments (code book, recon, etc…), the one that stands out for me as a puppet master is the final live stream on Twitch. I see a lot of untapped potential in this, and I want us to explore it more.

-Mother Russia allowed us to increase the level of role playing content within a mission set with the Msika Archive, an in-depth lore document. We want to test similar deeper lore artifacts and see how we can better balanced it with the puzzle and the ARG components.

-Mother Russia had a lot of lore and content to explore, but was a little short on the number of puzzles. I think we could increase the amount of puzzles and their challenge without having any impact on the quality or the cost of the DLC.

Therefore, we see three next steps for The Black Watchmen: A dedicated live event hub, a new DLC that you will vote on and a new hint mechanic.


1. DEDICATED LIVE EVENT HUB
We have been attempting to centralize the live event experience in a core hub for a long time, and the response to the stream at the end of Operation SILVERSPEAR was so positive that we decided to create the Coordination & Operations Management (COM) Division. The COM Division website hub will be open during a live event and will be personalized (using your in-game agent login) for an optimal browser and mobile experience (aka field work).

The hub will feature:

-Twitch stream and live chat
-Collective progression of the event so far
-Rewards and achievement you have completed
-Time and date in UTC (no more shit i missed it)
-Agent participation, which could be organized by class, groups, territory or blood type
-Deeper interaction with Dispatch through radar monitoring, interactive maps, strategic deployment, resources management, etc...
-Links to Archive documents about the current event
-Mobile support to submit field intel

 (!) PREVIEW: (VERY EARLY!) wireframe of the COM Division hub	

2. NEW DLC
We are excited to test this hub in a new live event. We will send a survey to see where your interests lie for this next Special Operation DLC. You will also vote on the theme of the DLC and the mechanics you would like to see us explore. As with Mother Russia, this DLC will include:

-5 new missions (with Video Cutscenes)
-Around 25 puzzles (+40% over Mother Russia)
-A new live event
-Cost of 5$
-Target Launch Date - End of October, early November


3. HINT MECHANIC
Finally, we want to provide a large quality of life improvement for the agents playing Season 1 and Season 2. For this, we will introduce the Surveillance and Information Management (SIM) Division. Accessible within the game, it will feature multiple hints broken down by puzzle. The SIM Division is actually relying on curated Intel from agents; integrating hints from the forums thread into the client. Agents who contributed to the hints will be credited. We encourage agents to continue contributing hint in the forums, SIM Division will review this intel and use it to expand our global help system.


 (!) PREVIEW: (VERY EARLY!) wireframe of the SIM Division	


-- AHNAYRO 
Ahnayro continues to evolve and grow. It has already helped us bring 976 new players to the community in Early Access alone but more impressive; 63% of Ahnayro players bought a copy of The Black Watchmen. By the end of the year, we hope to bring an additional 2000 players to the community.

Table 2 is about to be launched and we plan for an official release at the end of September. A special quest line will also be unlockable only by Black Watchmen “Scientist” Class.


 (!) PREVIEW: Dream fragment from Table 2	


-- NITE Team 4
We will need your help to determine the future of NITE Team 4. At the moment, we have the funds to deliver a project at the scale of Ahnayro, reaching out to a different audience (hacker experience) and helping us expand The Black Watchmen universe. But we have a larger vision for NITE Team 4. We believe it can span into a much bigger project, something along the lines of The Black Watchmen Season 1. Including advanced mechanics, narrative, voice actors, content and its own original soundtrack.


 (!) PREVIEW: NT4 Kickstarter Promo	

We decided to turn to Kickstarter to see if there is interest in a “Hacker Experience” game like NT4. If successful, this will also bring visibility and new players to the Black Watchmen universe. Like in Ahnayro, we also plan to have a NITE Team 4 special quest line unlockable only by Black Watchmen “Cybertech” Class. To be clear: the Kickstarter funding will simply define how far we can push NITE Team 4 in terms of mechanics and content.

The Kickstarter for NITE Team 4 will go live in the next two weeks. With your support, we can make this game better!


-- CONCLUSION
Now that Mother Russia madness is over, we are back and ready to work! Looking forward to
your feedback on NITE Team 4, Ahnayro and The Black Watchmen

- Anashel 

   SOURCE 
Our Steam Game Links -  Ahnayro	 ---  The Black Watchmen    ---  NITE Team 4

notes.title: Operation DARKAVALON - Update 3
notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/WB8aEJD.jpg
http://i.imgur.com/nrrNQbz.jpg


AGENTS,

1. Action required:
Use STINGER to hack into the Chinese Consulate in Vancouver and shut down the security camera system, so we can covertly insert a strike team to retrieve Agent MidDipper.

2. Background:
With the assistance of Omicron, we were alerted to the disappearance of Agent Middipper. Using a GPS device hidden on her person, we tracked her to movements from Boston to the Vancouver Airport. However, the device went offline shortly afterwards, en route to central Vancouver. We suspect MidDipper is being held within Vancouver. Our contact within the Vancouver International Airport provided us with a passenger manifest of the flight MidDipper and her captors took from Boston. Four names were flagged on the flight, all members of Klaymore Securities, a paramilitary contractor. It appears that MidDipper was kidnapped by Klaymore. 

3. Updates:
Agent MidDipper was located at the Chinese Consulate in Vancouver, after the cursed flowers were removed and we exploited their network through a hacking operation by our Green Level agent. We now need to blind the consulate security camera system so we can covertly insert a strike team for a rescue operation. Read the security camera exploit guide  Archive #YJ98NC.	  and use the stinger-cm command in the STINGER terminal to hack the system.

4. Recommendation: 
(a) Read the STINGER security camera exploit guide  Archive #YJ98NC.	  and enter the commands at http://stinger.blackwatchmen.com.

(b) Obtain the admin password for the security system and relay success code to Dispatch [dispatch@division-66.com].

(c) Join the global agent network in the investigation on IRC at irc.blackwatchmen.com - #division66 ( https://kiwiirc.com/client/irc.blackwatchmen.com/division66 ).

(d) Monitor the Division 66 Twitter channel for updates on the operation (  @Division66	 )..

 Link

notes.notes:

http://i.imgur.com/nrrNQbz.jpg

AGENTS,

1. Action required:
 Green Level agent has been dispatched in the Vancouver, Canada area. They require your support in completing a field mission. Help them locate artifacts blocking Omicron from finding our missing agent.

2. Background:
 With the assistance of Omicron, we were alerted to the disappearance of Agent Middipper. Using a GPS device hidden on her person, we tracked her movements from Boston to the Vancouver International Airport. However, the device went offline shortly afterwards, en route to central Vancouver. We suspect MidDipper is being held within Vancouver. Our contact within the Vancouver International Airport provided us with a passenger manifest of the flight MidDipper and her captors took from Boston. Four names were flagged on the flight, all members of Klaymore Securities, a paramilitary contractor. It appears that MidDipper was kidnapped by Klaymore.    


3. Updates:
 Subject Omicron is unable to obtain a vision of MidDipper’s current position. Our Green Level agent in Vancouver has been activated to aide in the rescue attempt. Following a lead on the kidnappers, they intercepted a drop containing multiple artifacts. Omicron believes these artifacts, along with others scattered around Vancouver, block her from locating our missing agent. Our Green Level agent is ready to disable all further artifacts within the area, once they are located. 

4. Recommendation:
 (a) Read the Omicron Unit report on the artifacts found in Vancouver and help locate the 4 remaining artifacts   Archive #NX74VY.	 .

 (b) Relay locations to the Green Level agent for field removal via IRC at irc.blackwatchmen.com - #division66 
 ( https://kiwiirc.com/client/irc.blackwatchmen.com/division66 ).

 (c) Monitor the Division 66 Twitter channel for updates on the operation (  @Division66	 ).

notes.title: Operation RUBYDRAGON Update #3
notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/NXRKIqQ.jpg

 AGENTS	

 1. Action required: 
Investigate the IRIS Network Twitter bot page (@MacArthurPincer) and determine the new key source being used so we can get updates on the target/operation.

 2. Background: 	
Falcon Recon Team 3 was observing the residence of Aconite Capital CFO Oran Plaskett when he left his home in the middle of the night and traveled to a nearby park. It was at this location where he was killed by an unknown sniper whose whereabouts are currently unknown. The CFO was having regular encrypted message exchanges with a third party and we must investigate them to verify if they are a credible threat.

  3. Updates:
The IRIS Network Twitter bot changed its key source and we are unable to issue commands to the bot. We need analyst help to regain our foothold in the network so we can obtain updates on the IRIS Network. 

  4. Recommendation:
  (a) Go to the IRIS Network Twitter bot page and find the new key it is using.

  (b)  Report news of any change in IRIS Network status or commands to Dispatch   dispatch@division-66.com	

  (c)  Join the global agent network in the investigation on IRC   (HERE)	

  (d)  Monitor the Division 66 Twitter channel for updates on the operation . 
 @division66

notes.title: Operation RUBYDRAGON Update #2
notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/NXRKIqQ.jpg

 AGENTS	

 1. Action required: 
Obtain recon photos of Chinatown gates across the world to gather intel on possible occult activity as part of IRIS Network Operation ARCHANGEL.

 2. Background: 	
Falcon Recon Team 3 was observing the residence of Aconite Capital CFO Oran Plaskett when he left his home in the middle of the night and traveled to a nearby park. It was at this location where he was killed by an unknown sniper whose whereabouts are currently unknown. The CFO was having regular encrypted message exchanges with a third party and we must investigate them to verify if they are a credible threat.

  3. Updates: 
The agents at Office of Analysis were able to decrypt several encrypted communications between Oran Plaskett and IRIS. This led them to a covert Twitter network with a bot designed to relay IRIS operation info to their members. We infiltrated the network and obtained information about an operation to gather rift energies from Chinatown archways (codenamed Operation ARCHANGEL). We need to get recon photos of these areas to gather intel on the IRIS group.

 4. Recommendation: 
  (a)  Take recon photos of Chinatown archways in your area of operations. 

  (b) Submit photos to  Dispatch   dispatch@division-66.com	  with your agent name and the GPS coordinates of the Chinatown you performed recon in.

  (c)  Join the global agent network in the investigation on IRC   (HERE)	

  (d)  Monitor the Division 66 Twitter channel for updates on the operation .

notes.title: End of Season 1 Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

With the final set of missions released and the final live-event having passed, we thought we'd give you a small update on how things went, and what you can expect moving forward.

Season 1 Retrospective
We thought it would be nice to share the gritty statistics of Season 1 with all of you, so for those of you who are interested, here they are:

Client Missions:
Number of missions: 25
Total number of puzzles to solve: 65
Average playtime for players who finished Season 1: 41 hours
Total time played: 24 966 hours
Unique Agents: 4021 in 65 countries

Live Missions:
Number of Live Missions: 5
Number of Live Mission community-wide puzzles: 40
Location specific real-world event objectives: 6 cities

Game & Narrative Content:
Documents created for In-Client Missions: 84
Websites created for In-Client Missions: 8
Packages sent out: 350
Phone calls: 1131

We would like to send a big 'Thank You!' to everyone who participated in Season 1, and for all your support - we are unspeakably proud of our community, and we would never have been able to get this far without you!

Moving Forward
Season 2:
We have a tentative release date set for sometime in November or December.
The price for Season 2 will be 25 USD, and Season 1 will be 15 USD.
Keep in mind that anyone who buys the game before the 30th of September, gets both Season 1 and the upcoming Season 2 for 35 USD!

While you wait
We will be opening "Community Missions" at the start of October. 
These are missions that members from our own community have produced and voted for, and the first 3 are already being produced by their respective creators.  
To those who have received the necessary amounts of votes for their submissions, but haven't heard from us yet: Don't Panic! We'll be releasing the Community Missions a few at a time, to ensure that our Agents can keep fit for the entire time up until Season 2 makes its way in - this means that you will be contacted once it's your turn to test the skill of your fellow Agents.

notes.title: Steam Dev Update #004
notes.notes:
PAX PROMOTION!
Just in time for PAX Prime, we are excited to announce that all those who buy the game between now (Aug 26th) and the end of September will receive free access to Season 2, set to be released in late 2015.


RETURN OF THE SANDBOX MISSION
Interested in crafting your own Black Watchmen Mission? We are also thrilled to announce the return of community Sandbox missions! The community missions will be released periodically between the end of Season 1 and the beta testing of Season 2. Start planning your missions now and submit it to the forums for vote. The top mission will be selected and publish within the game.

To submit your mission, visit:
http://forums.blackwatchmen.com/index.php?threads/sandbox-mission.828/


ALREADY GOT THE GAME?
Everyone who bought the game during the early access or who supported us via KickStarter will get a free copy of Season 2!

notes.title: Steam Dev Update #003
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Time for new missions! We are releasing 5 new missions in the client, plus a new live mission which will happen sometime in the upcoming weeks. Exciting!

The training wheels are off agents. These are harder missions, that take more research and deduction. But fear not, the community is here to help. This is a collaborative game, so be sure to ask your fellow agents for help in the game, on the forums (http://forums.blackwatchmen.com) and the irc (Freenode, channel #division66). You must all work together with you to solve what lies ahead.

And of course, if you have any questions or concerns, feel free to post them on this forum, or else contact Anashel, Crux or Jarobi on our forums or IRC channel.

Good luck agents!

notes.title: Steam Dev Update #002
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Thank you for all your support and well done on all your progress so far! 

First we wanted to commend everyone for their excellent work and fantastic behaviour during our first live event! The folks @ The Fried Onion were thrilled by the experience!

Meanwhile, validation of clearance level orange and yellow is underway and new updates to the game client were done to fix as many bugs as we could.

A demo of the client has been approved by Steam and will likely be released on Monday.

Based on your feedback, we are excited to announce 6 new missions for season 1, for a total of 25 missions + 5 hidden missions + live events. As soon as we can, we will announce more!

As a small indie developer (5 people), we wish to extend our thanks to all the community! You have been incredibly supportive and extremely helpful to us, as well as each other.

This is the last weekend before the launch of the game, we are looking forward to entertaining you in the upcoming months!

Please do not hesitate to contact us if you have any questions!


PS: For people who love stats:
- 3 913 hours played so far
- 26 346 attempts to solve puzzles
- 7 706 puzzles solved 
- 3 184 missions completed
- 1 530 calls for help

notes.title: Steam Dev Update #001
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!
 
Thank you for all your support and the great reviews we have so far!  The early access is going well, we had very few bugs so far with the steam framework and we had no downtime.
 
Agents completed 1576 missions and submitted 12,466 answers for a total of 1476 hours of gameplay!
 
In terms of improvement, we plan to add some features in the game settings for support to older graphic cards. We also wish to reiterate that personal information IS OPTIONAL and is only used to send you puzzles by mail or phone.
 
To complete our early access test, we will deploy our first community live event; we hope you will enjoy it and work together to solve this puzzle! Keep in mind this is still an early access and the goal is to get your feedback to improve the game!

All the dev team can be reach on the forums or on IRC, if you have any concerns or ideas, please do not hesitate to contact us! We have been working on this game for over a year, and are thrilled to finally release it to the community on Steam. We are excited to continue to work with all of you to ensure the best possible experience for all our players. 
 
Best,
- Anashel
